item.tib: rin chen gter mdzod kyi zhi ba tshe ru sgrub pa zla dkar 'khor lo'i rgyud las cha lag thugs rje'i sprin dpung
item.coloph: de ltar tshe sgrub rgyud gzhung la/ zur du sgrub pa bskyal ba'i tshe/ kha skong 'di ltar dgos zhes pa/ stag sprul gshen bstan bka' nan ngor/ kho bo bde chen gling pa yi/ (yis) cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar tshes su/ zhes zhol gsang ba'i khrod du brtsams/ dge bas rang gzhan don 'grub smon//
